release_notes: Pick up or purchase a key, then use R, the mouse wheel, or right-click to rotate it; touch players can double-tap. The trajectory preview updates immediately.
Key incline and launch distance remain fixed. Labels and prompts now clearly distinguish adjustable DIR from fixed ARC.
Completed routes now play authored eight-note melodies through a beat-aligned monophonic sequencer instead of overlapping collision chords.
Rotation persists across placement and saves, while cancelling a move restores the original direction.
Full npm test suite passed and the web export built successfully. Browser smoke serving was blocked only by the restricted environment’s localhost permission.
